subject.title: Telegram: specific forum topic becomes permanent inbound black hole after stuck-session recovery

question: Should OpenClaw treat the restart-surviving Telegram forum-topic black hole as a separate routing/binding recovery bug beyond the in-process guarded-lane timeout work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93040?
rationale: Current source proves the guarded-lane precursor but does not explain state that survives process restart, and the linked PR is neither merged nor sufficient for the persistent forum-topic evidence.

options.title: Keep Separate Persistent-Topic Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open for live repro and a fix that covers post-restart fresh-message routing/binding state, while treating https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93040 as only a partial overlap.

options.title: Fold Into Guarded-Lane Canonical
options.body: Move the remaining evidence under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91456 only if maintainers decide the persistent topic symptom has the same root cause and will be fixed by the same recovery contract.

options.title: Wait For Live Telegram Proof
options.body: Pause implementation until a maintainer or reporter supplies a live Telegram repro showing which persisted state or binding drops fresh topic messages after restart.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Persistent-Topic Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for live repro and a fix that covers post-restart fresh-message routing/binding state, while treating https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93040 as only a partial overlap.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the strongest recent area-history candidate from the current release-tagged polling-session source and test snapshot.
